review_method: Opened full RGB/native scene montage, four fit views, final full plate rendered from PDF with PyMuPDF 1.28.2, and enlarged C/D panels; no clipped labels, physical sections or helmet; continuous bare-head band and industrial clothing visible.
notes: Midpoint up view includes actual head at image edge; down view retains actual body and clothing.
Gentle category shading preserves scene detail. Category callout anchors are computed from label-mask distance transforms, not hand-selected coverage regions.
Forward scene mostly has three-camera overlap; 639 only-C0 pixels are retained, not expanded artificially.
Skin and clothing are open meshes: static surface audit plus visual review does not prove comfort or mechanical fit.
